correctness.rationale: Read frozen RESULT.md and checker.py. Starting from the explicitly credited Sun quadratic ground-state form, shell-constant h-weighted profiles have energy B[(1+r)/(1-r)I-T_M(r)] with T_ij=r^abs(i-j), r=p^(-(n+alpha)/2). Inverse of T is standard tridiagonal Kac–Murdock–Szegö; positive cosine vector satisfies both endpoint equations, hence is Perron eigenvector and gives the sharp radial eigenvalue. Its pointwise shell eigen-equation with strictly positive profile yields by a second ground-state transform an all-angular, full-function nonnegative kernel remainder; connected positive kernel enforces equality only at constant quotient, so only the radial profile attains sharpness. Principal block strict top-eigenvalue growth and endpoint phase expansion give monotonicity and B*pi^2*r*(1+r)/((1-r)^3*(M+s)^2)+O(M^-4). Independently diagonalized 12 Toeplitz matrices with r=0.03,0.15,0.4 and M=1,2,4,10 and matched root characterizations to 2e-12. This corroborates, rather than substitutes for, the exact analytic argument; original primary Sun full-text authentication remained inaccessible.
